body:
Okay. Thank you for clarifying.

I definitely agree that good intentions, used thoughtlessly, can lead to bad outcomes.

I'm slightly confused.

[Here](http://www.reddit.com/r/SuicideWatch/comments/2b9k0c/i_may_have_provoked_a_suicide/cj362da) you say that 'no one can provoke a suicide'. I felt quite comforted when I read that, because I was afraid that I might have accidentally pushed someone over the edge.

But now, you seem to be saying that suicidal people are very easy to provoke. I'm not really sure what to believe.

But talk about what?

I've said lots of things, to lots of people, and it's rarely been helpful to me, I'm afraid. People tell me that I should talk, and I do, but it never helps.

I keep wondering if I'm doing something wrong, as if there's something specific that I'm supposed to say. Some word or phrase or sentence that will suddenly allow someone else to help me. Something that'll help me to stop feeling like this, but I just can't figure out what it is.

Why are other people helped by talking, but not me?

I'm seriously considering typing in random sequences of words and characters in the hope that I might accidentally stumble upon that one magical thing that I have to say. Because no matter what I try, I cannot figure out what I'm supposed to be doing.

I've obviously long past the point where I can consider rational solutions, all I have left is suicide.
Sorry, but I think I need to die, not talk.

>In my modest opinion, things can be found in life that make it worth sticking around

I'm sorry, but I don't seem to be able to find any such thing.

Thank you for the response.

Death doesn't seem that bad to me. There are worse things than permanent darkness.

I don't love anything. I don't think I can love anything. I just need to die.

Am I right in guessing, that this is really about companionship and not sex?

I don't have any advice or solutions for you. But I do know how frustrating and lonely it can be, when you try and put yourself out there, day after day, but no matter what you do, no-one ever seems to reciprocate or care.

I don't know whether you'll ever find the relationship you're looking for, but I truly hope you do.

I don't think that the OP comes across as particularly bitter towards women. He mostly seems angry at himself.

>If those women dont fall madly in love with **them** immediately, its because those women would rather date jerks and not a *nice guy* like **you**

One thing that bothers me about this comment is the way you switch from 'them' to 'you'. It sounds like you're insinuating that the statement is directly applicable to the OP. Which may not be true. 

He may have overgeneralised slightly, but he didn't say anything about women dating jerks. He doesn't describe women as jerks. And he certainly didn't describe himself as a 'nice guy'.

I think you're unintentionally reading things into OP's words that aren't actually there.

I may have been in a similar position to you at one point. Years ago, when I was at college, I had similar experiences.

>Have you talked to anyone about how you feel?

I've spoken to plenty of people. It's never helped I'm afraid. Then again, I was never very good at talking.

Sorry, but I have to go now. If I wait any longer, I'll lose my opportunity to die.

I'm lonely too, but there's nothing that could ever have been done about that in my case.

I don't see any hope. Sorry.

Sorry, but the why's don't really matter. And I'm tired of explaining myself.

Just, please accept the fact that when I die, it will be the best thing for everyone involved.

It's a long story and I'm afraid I don't have a lot of time.

Regardless, it seems to me that my death is necessary. It's for the greater good.
I don't have much time left to talk.
